title: Customer Behavior Analysis
description: Customer Shopping Behavior Analysis using Python, PostgreSQL, SQL, and Power BI. This project performs end-to-end data analysis, including data cleaning, feature engineering, SQL-based business insights, and an interactive Power BI dashboard to analyze customer purchasing patterns, product performance, subscription behavior, and revenue trends.

title: Smart-Sheet AI
description: An AI-powered spreadsheet application that enables users to interact with sheets using natural language, execute formulas automatically, and perform smart data extraction.
